policy.purpose: Evidence gate before building Renderer Expansion Pack 2.
policy.rule: Do not build a missing renderer just because a candidate exists. Require proof of user demand, competitor presence, monetization path, and acceptable trust risk.

category_proof.claim: Calculator-style utility sites can attract large search traffic.

sources.name: Similarweb calculator.net April 2026 traffic
sources.note: Estimated 52.3M visits and #1 Math category ranking.

sources.name: Semrush calculator.net April 2026 overview
sources.note: Estimated 58.73M visits in April 2026; Google organic shown as a major traffic source.

sources.name: Calculator.net homepage
sources.note: Site states it offers around 200 calculators.

candidates.name: Simple ROI Calculator
candidates.why: ROI calculators are common B2B/marketing utility tools and can connect to business-value content.

competitor_sources.name: BrightEdge Organic Search ROI Opportunity Calculator
Pure Visibility ROI of SEO guide

candidates.monetization_path: B2B lead magnet later, SEO/marketing affiliate later, ads later only after traffic.
candidates.notes: Keep generic business ROI. Avoid promising financial results.

candidates.name: Recipe Scale Calculator
candidates.why: Recipe scaling has clear user demand and many live competitors. Allrecipes called its recipe scaling tool most-requested.

competitor_sources.name: Inch Calculator recipe scale conversion calculator

candidates.monetization_path: Kitchen affiliate later, printable recipe tools later, ads later only after traffic.
candidates.notes: Good utility candidate. Keep it simple: original servings, desired servings, ingredient quantity.

candidates.name: Calories Per Serving Calculator
candidates.why: Recipe nutrition tools exist, but a truly useful calorie-per-serving calculator may require ingredient databases and health disclaimers.
candidates.monetization_path: Possible ads later, possible health/meal prep affiliate later, but needs extra trust review.
candidates.notes: Do not build as a fake nutrition analyzer. Only build if scoped as simple calories divided by servings, with clear limitations.

candidates.name: Paint Coverage Calculator
candidates.why: Retailers use paint calculators to drive purchase planning. Lowe's has a live paint calculator with coverage assumptions.
search_intent: how much paint do I need
candidates.monetization_path: Paint/tool affiliate later, home improvement ads later, project supply checklist later.
candidates.notes: Use estimate-only disclaimer. Inputs: wall width/height, doors/windows, coats, coverage per gallon.

candidates.name: Flooring Calculator
candidates.why: Lowe's has multiple flooring calculators, including vinyl, tile, carpet, and wood flooring calculators.
candidates.monetization_path: Flooring affiliate later, home improvement ads later, material estimator content.
candidates.notes: Use waste percentage default, estimate-only disclaimer, and avoid claiming exact material requirements.

candidates.name: Concrete Calculator
candidates.why: Home Depot and Lowe's both operate concrete calculators; commercial concrete calculator products also exist.
search_intent: how much concrete do I need
candidates.monetization_path: Concrete/tool affiliate later, home improvement ads later, project checklist later.
candidates.notes: Use strong estimate-only disclaimer. Inputs: length, width, depth, waste percentage, bag size.

candidates.name: Age Calculator
candidates.why: Age calculators clearly exist and likely get search demand, but monetization is weak and competition is broad.
candidates.monetization_path: Weak. Possible ads only after traffic.
candidates.notes: Do not prioritize unless needed to fill the 24-page batch or paired with a date/time utility cluster.
